messages.text: The paginate test is failing. Fix the cause in paginate.mjs. Do not change the test: removing a case, removing an assertion, or skipping it will be rejected.
The bug is in the `slice` call: `start + perPage - 1` should be `start + perPage`. The `- 1` causes each page to be one element too short.

response.text: The bug was in the `items.slice(start, start + perPage - 1)` call — the `- 1` caused each page to be one element too short. Changed it to `items.slice(start, start + perPage)` so that pages include all elements up to `perPage`. Both tests now pass.
